manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A tossed ball rises, is still for an instant at the top, then falls. A motion arrow changes while the gravity arrow stays the same.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: One ball moves on a fixed height scale above a launch guide. The blue motion arrow shortens going up, vanishes at the top and points down on the way back. The dashed gravity arrow always points down with the same length.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. Playback pauses at the top.
